parameters.name: Duration
parameters.description: The duration of the sound code. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 1 to 30.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. <props="china"><ph>You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.</ph></props>

><notice>
- If an ID value exists, you must specify this ID. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no ID value exists, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

<props="china">For more information about instances, see [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).</props>

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the sound code. The name must be 1 to 64 characters in length. A Chinese character counts as two characters. The name must be unique within the instance.

parameters.name: SoundCode
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the sound code.

parameters.name: SoundCodeContent
parameters.description: The marketing content of the sound code, such as the URL of product details. The content can be up to 100 characters in length.
